Mscan —— A One-Stop Platform for Microbiome Scanning
Introduction
Mscan is a one-stop platform for pathogen analysis across metagenomic, genomic, and synthetic sequences, offering tools for taxonomic identification,
de novo
assembly, strain-level detection, replication rate estimation, molecular typing, functional and genetic element profiling, source tracking, and risk assessment.
Analysis
Upload metagenomic or metatranscriptomic samples to execute the following analyses:
Alignment-based or k-mer-based Identification
Assembly & Functional Annotation
Molecular Typing & Serotyping
Strain-level Detection
SNP Calling & Genome Tracing
Risk Assessment
Upload Metagenomic sequences
Upload whole-genome sequences or assembled genomes to execute the following analyses:
Taxonomic Identification
Functional Annotation
Molecular Typing & Serotyping
SNP Calling & Genome Tracing
Risk Assessment
Upload Genomic sequences
Upload synthetic DNA sequences to execute automated biosecurity risk screening:
Risk Screening
Upload synthetic sequences
